mostWorthwhile.text: Binding oxygen to red blood cells was most worthwhile: the result explained that haemoglobin can release oxygen where dissolved oxygen is low, connecting the sample to working tissues.

leastWorthwhile.text: Combining plasma water and solutes was straightforward, but the resulting description added little beyond showing the ingredients together.

surprise.text: The two-way oxygen binding explanation clarified that haemoglobin releases oxygen as well as picking it up.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the item titles and descriptions gave each combination a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter if it showed how circulation delivers oxygen to the arm. This chapter made the blood components clear, though most combinations were predictable.
